body.para: Appends a record to a table and fills it with values from expressions, memory variables, an array or an object.

INSERT INTO <TableName> [(<FieldName1> [, <FieldName2> ...])] VALUES (<eExpression1> [, <eExpression2> ...])
INSERT INTO <TableName> FROM MEMVAR
INSERT INTO <TableName> FROM ARRAY <ArrayName>
INSERT INTO <TableName> FROM NAME <ObjectName>
<TableName>The table to which the record is added. If the table is not open in any work area, then it is opened, used for the insert and closed again.
(<FieldName1>, ...)The fields that receive a value. If the field list is omitted the values are stored in the fields in field order.
VALUES (<eExpression1>, ...)The values for the fields. The values are converted to the type of the field when possible.
FROM MEMVARTakes the values from memory variables that have the same names as the fields. Fields without a variable with the same name are not changed.
FROM ARRAY <ArrayName>Takes the values from the elements of the array, starting with the first element for the first field.
FROM NAME <ObjectName>Takes the values from properties of the object that have the same names as the fields.
NOT SUPPORTED AT THIS MOMENT: The INSERT INTO ... SELECT variation. The compiler generates an error when it is used.

INSERT INTO Customers (Id, Name) VALUES (1, "Smith")
LOCAL oCustomer := TestObject{} AS OBJECT
INSERT INTO Customers FROM NAME oCustomer
APPEND BLANK, GATHER, UPDATE, DELETE FROM
